minutes.headline: Select Board appointed three Sewer Commission members, set a town manager posting salary, and raised ambulance rates.
minutes.summary: The board interviewed four Sewer Commission applicants jointly with the commission and appointed three. It approved a town manager posting salary on the consultant's advice, approved a Boys and Girls Club haunted house, and sent a letter to the governor seeking aid for the Nashoba hospital closure. It also approved an ambulance write-off and new ambulance rates, and pressed the interim town manager on committing ARPA funds before the deadline. Minutes were not approved, and the goals workshop was postponed.

budget_items.what_was_said: A resident said upgrading about 141 users from basic to standard would cost a modest extra amount in municipal terms.
The consultant recommended posting a midpoint with plus or minus. The previous salary and a deferred comp percentage were recalled.
A member noted benefits and taxes push total cost well above the salary.
The motion set the posting salary.
The chief estimated extra costs from longer transports and mutual aid, and a letter asks the state to include Lunenburg in aid.
Staff listed uncollectible categories, with a previous write-off recalled.
Chief said rates have not changed in 8 to 10 years, and the billing company estimated added revenue.
Finance committee approved support for the transportation fund until town meeting.

decisions.decision: Motions on Sewer Commission appointments would come from the Select Board, taking the commission's recommendation first.
A member will contact the unappointed applicant about the Finance Committee.
Interim town manager will work toward getting meeting packets out the Thursday before meetings, possibly Friday, with supplements allowed.
Decision on withdrawing ARPA funds deferred to the October 1 meeting; interim town manager to prepare an alternative equipment-purchase plan.
Minutes were not approved; a separate informal workshop on procedures and goals will be scheduled.
Interim town manager will provide a schedule summary of facilities projects.
A volunteer-recruitment letter will go in the fall town meeting warrant mailing.
The goals workshop was postponed to another night.

what_happened.line: The Select Board appointed three Sewer Commission members to a term ending at the 2025 annual election, after interviewing applicants jointly with the commission.
The board voted unanimously to approve new ambulance rates as proposed by the chief, after hearing that rates had not changed in 8 to 10 years.
The board approved a town manager posting salary, with a plus-or-minus range, on the consultant's advice and sent it to the screening committee.
The board approved writing off uncollectible ambulance accounts and sending a letter to the governor seeking aid for the Nashoba hospital closure.
The board deferred the decision on withdrawing ARPA funds to October 1 and did not approve minutes; the goals workshop was postponed.

why_it_matters: The ambulance rate change sets what residents and their insurers are billed for transport, and the write-off shows part of that billing is never collected.
The town manager posting salary and the Sewer Commission appointments shape who runs town government and a sewer service residents pay for.
Unspent ARPA money has a deadline, so the deferred decision affects whether planned equipment purchases go ahead with that federal money or need another source.
